note: Design data for docs/design/strategy.md and the in-game counter hints (loadout screen). tools/gen_counters.mjs builds the counter table and runs the design checks from this file; stats live in data/units.json and data/enemies.json.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.read: small, low and many, arriving in packs of 5-8
swarm.rule: Fast and weak; arrive in packs that surround single-target crew.

flying.name: Flying
flying.read: off the ground with a shadow below it
flying.rule: Melee cannot hit it. It flies over the front line to the back line and the fort.

siege.name: Siege
siege.read: tall, stays at the back, lobs glowing globs
siege.rule: Out-ranges every crew shooter. Targets the back line, then the fort.

exploder.name: Exploder
exploder.rule: Bursts when it dies and hurts everyone close, crew and monsters.

armoured.name: Armoured
armoured.rule: Takes 12 less damage from every hit, so many small hits do almost nothing.

shelled.name: Shelled
shelled.read: carries a ship's bell or shell in front of it
shelled.rule: The shell soaks the first 300 damage from the front. Blunt and blast hits break it at once.

healer.name: Healer
healer.read: soft glowing bell-shape floating low, a beam to whoever it mends
healer.rule: Mends the most hurt monster nearby. A fight in front of it never ends.

venomous.name: Venomous
venomous.rule: Each hit adds a stack of poison.

submerged.name: Submerged
submerged.read: a moving ripple and fin in the sand
submerged.rule: Cannot be targeted while under the sand. Surfaces at the first crew member it passes, behind the front line.

ghostly.name: Ghostly
ghostly.rule: Blades, shot and cannonballs pass through. Only fire and light hurt it; in lantern light it turns solid.

crew.name: Hatchguard
crew.job: Wall. His door blocks blasts and poison from the front.
crew.weakness: Hits lightly, cannot reach the air, out-ranged.

crew.name: Blackpowder
crew.job: Shooter. Burning shot reaches the air, burn ignores armour, fire hurts ghosts.
crew.weakness: Slow reload: packs swamp him. Shells soak his shots.

crew.name: Rope Rat
crew.job: Diver. Vaults the front line to knife whatever hides at the back, and gets behind shells.
crew.weakness: Fragile: dies to blasts, poison and big hits.

crew.name: Shantyman
crew.job: Crowd control. His song slows everything in earshot.
crew.weakness: Does no damage himself; siege out-ranges the song.

crew.name: Anchorman
crew.job: Breaker. One huge blunt hit: cracks armour, smashes shells, and the slam drives the buried up.
crew.weakness: Slow swing: packs and fliers ignore him.

crew.name: Sawbones
crew.job: Mender. Heals crew, cleans off poison, and his lantern makes ghosts solid.
crew.weakness: Cannot fight; dies to anything that reaches him.

crew.name: Harpooner
crew.job: Sniper. One long, slow, piercing shot that ignores armour and out-ranges siege.
crew.weakness: One target at a time; useless against packs.

crew.name: Netcaster
crew.job: Catcher. Nets drag fliers to the ground and pin whatever they land on.
crew.weakness: No damage; ghosts drift through the net.

crew.name: Fire-eater
crew.job: Burner. A short cone of flame.
crew.weakness: Must stand close; shells and armour shrug it off until they burn.

crew.name: Lookout
crew.job: Spotter. Marks the buried and the unseen so everyone can hit them; marked monsters take more damage.
crew.weakness: Barely fights.

crew.name: Boathook
crew.job: Giant-killer. Long reach, double damage to anything big.
crew.weakness: Clumsy against small fast things.

crew.name: Powder Monkey
crew.job: Bomber. Lobs a keg: blast damage in a circle, breaks shells.
crew.weakness: Long fuse; fast things are gone before it lands.

crew.name: Gull-rider
crew.job: Flier. Crosses the field in the air to hit siege and menders, and duels other fliers.
crew.weakness: Thin; one shooter brings her down.

crew.name: Chaplain
crew.job: Blesser. A ring of light: ghosts inside are solid and burn.
crew.weakness: Slow, short reach.

crew.name: Diver
crew.job: Brass-suit tank. Immune to poison, fights the buried under the sand.
crew.weakness: Very slow, very dear.

crew.name: Grapnel
crew.job: Puller. Hooks one monster out of its line and drags it to the crew.
crew.weakness: One at a time; cannot pull the big ones.

crew.name: Swivel Gun
crew.job: Line gun. A shot that passes through a whole row.
crew.weakness: Cannot aim up; needs a wall in front.

crew.name: Cooper
crew.job: Builder. Rolls out a barrel wall that blocks the beach for a while.
crew.weakness: The wall does nothing to what goes over or under it.

crew.name: Colour Sergeant
crew.job: Flag. Crew near the colours hit harder and cannot be stunned.
crew.weakness: Useless alone.

crew.name: Storm-caller
crew.job: Weather. Calls lightning that chains through wet monsters and strikes the air first.
crew.weakness: Long wait between strikes.

enemies.name: Gallows Gull
enemies.look: a skeletal sea-bird trailing a frayed noose of kelp; flaps above head height

enemies.name: Bellback
enemies.look: a hermit crab the size of a man living in a drowned ship's bell it holds in front like a ram

enemies.name: Tide Nurse
enemies.look: a pale jellyfish bell drifting at waist height with long ribbons; a green thread runs to whoever it mends

enemies.name: Spinefoot
enemies.look: an urchin on long stilt legs, all spines

enemies.name: Sandjaw
enemies.look: an eel-thing that swims under the beach: a fin and a ripple until it lunges up

enemies.name: Selkie Rider
enemies.look: a seal-shape riding inside a wave that breaks on the beach

stages.name: Tide Turns Green
stages.teaches: Hold a line: a wall in front, a shooter behind.
stages.wrong: Only shooters: nothing holds the Drowners off them.

stages.name: The Smugglers' Steps
stages.teaches: Swarm: packs run round a lone fighter and eat anyone soft. Bring a wall, slow them with the song, and aim the cannon at the pack.
stages.wrong: Shooter and singer, no wall: the Scuttlers run straight through to them and the fort.

stages.name: Gallows Roost
stages.teaches: Flying: melee cannot reach. Bring shooters or nets.
stages.wrong: All hand-to-hand: the Gulls pass overhead and peck the fort down.

stages.name: The Broken Lighthouse
stages.teaches: Siege: something at the back out-ranges you. Send a diver or a sniper.
stages.wrong: Wall, shooter, song and nets: ink falls on them from out of range all fight.

stages.name: Pufferghast Shoals
stages.teaches: Exploder: kill it at range or behind a door, never in a crowd.
stages.wrong: Rope Rats, song and nets, no door: each burst wipes the melee pile.

stages.name: Wreckers' Reef
stages.teaches: Armoured: small hits bounce. Bring one big hit or burn.
stages.wrong: Rope Rats and Netcasters with a wall: nothing they have gets through the plates.

stages.name: The Bell Ground
stages.teaches: Shelled and Healer together: break the shell, reach the mender.
stages.wrong: Wall, shooter, song and nets: the bells soak every shot and the Nurse undoes the rest.

stages.name: Mother Fathom
stages.teaches: The exam: she calls packs, spits ink and sends Gulls. No single answer.
stages.wrong: All hand-to-hand: the Gulls and the ink go where they cannot reach.

skills.note: Each crew member learns one skill at level 5 and chooses one of two at level 10. A skill changes what a crew member does, not just a number.

ashguard.5: Brace: while braced (standing still) the door also blocks ranged shots for those behind him.
10: Shove: every third block knocks the attacker back.
Taunt: monsters within reach must attack him first.

torchbow.5: Tar shot: burning shot leaves a small fire patch.
10: Grapeshot: every fourth shot splits into three.

netcaster.5: Weighted net: netted fliers fall and are stunned.
10: Hooked net: netted monsters take +25% damage.

recruiting.free: Some first clears give a crew member for nothing; they join with a short scene on the results screen.
recruiting.tavern: Others appear in the Tavern after a clear and cost doubloons. The Tavern also offers one rotating crew member from a later region early, at a high price.
recruiting.rule: Nothing is for real money. Every crew member can be earned by playing; buying early only spends doubloons sooner.
